questions.question_text: Premānand Svāmīnu kirtan shuru thāy chhe, "Ham to ek sahajānand gāve, Hamāre man _______ dūsro na bhāve." Khālī jagyā pūro.
questions.explanation: The kirtan by Premanand Swami states, "Ham to ek sahajānand gāve, Hamāre man svāminārāyaṇ dūsro na bhāve..."

questions.question_text: Premānand Svāmī kirtanmā kahe chhe ke, "___________ sār sugam sahajānand āve."
questions.explanation: The last line of Premanand Swami's kirtan is "Premānand sār sugam sahajānand āve..."

questions.question_text: "Paṇ jiyā lagī prāṇ raheshe, _______ svāmī sahajānand kaheshe; Teh vinā kahe bīju kem, paḍī ānṭī antarmā em." Khālī jagyā pūro.
questions.explanation: The kirtan states, "Paṇ jiyā lagī prāṇ raheshe, jībhā svāmī sahajānand kaheshe..."

questions.question_text: Kirtan pramāṇe, antarmā kī āṇṭī paḍī chhe ke ____ bīju kem kahe?
questions.explanation: The kirtan states, "Paṇ jiyā lagī prāṇ raheshe, jībhā svāmī sahajānand kaheshe; Teh vinā kahe bīju kem, paḍī ānṭī antarmā em."

questions.question_text: Kirtanmā shaṇā viṣhe kahyu chhe ke 'nāsā nahi liye sugandh nānī'?
questions.explanation: The kirtan mentions, "Tvachā nahi kare bheṭya bījānī, nāsā nahi liye sugandh nānī."

questions.question_text: Kirtan pramāṇe, _______ hari vinya bījo nishche nahi kare.
questions.explanation: The kirtan states, "Man nahi kare manan anya, buddhi nahi kare nishche hari vinya;"

questions.question_text: Kirtan pramāṇe, jyā lagī tan shvās rahe tyā lagī shu taju nahi?
questions.explanation: The kirtan states, "Māṭe jyā lagī rahe tan shvās, taju nahi tyā lagī e adhyās;"

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Ma.11 pramāṇe, Dharma, artha ane kām sambandhī je faḷnī ichchhā teno tyāg karīne tenā te shubh karma jo ______________ arthe kare to e ja shubh karma chhe te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.11 states, "...shubh karma jo bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe kare to e ja shubh karma chhe te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe."

questions.question_text: Vach.Ka.3 pramāṇe, gṛuhasth satsangīne paṇ jarūr rākhyā joie te be vānā kyā chhe?
questions.explanation: Vach.Ka.3 states, "Sharīrnu daman ne vichār e be vānā to gṛuhasth satsangīne paṇ jarūr rākhyā joie..."

questions.question_text: Purushottam Bolya Prite pramāṇe, Ekādashīnā vratnu faḷ koṭi _______ jeṭlu kahyu chhe.
questions.explanation: Purushottam Bolya Prite states, "Koṭi yagna jeṭlu ek ekādashīnā vratnu faḷ kahyu chhe."

questions.question_text: Purushottam Bolya Prite pramāṇe, Ekādashīnā divase anna khāy tene shaṇī tulya kahyu chhe?
questions.explanation: Purushottam Bolya Prite states, "Ekādashīnā divase anna khāy tene māns tulya kahyu chhe."

questions.question_text: Brahmānand Svāmī kirtanmā kahe chhe ke _______, evu vrat jāvā nav dījīe re.
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami's kirtan starts with "Koḍe koḍe ekādashī kījīe re, Evu vrat jāvā nav dījīe re..."

questions.question_text: Bhaktichintamani - 68/9 pramāṇe, Bhagwān kahe chhe ke "Mārā janne _______, jarūr māre āvvu; Birud māru e na badle, te sarve janne jaṇāvvu."
questions.explanation: Bhaktichintamani - 68/9 states, "Mārā janne antakāḷe, jarūr māre āvvu..."

questions.question_text: Brahmānand Svāmī kirtan pramāṇe, sāchā Harijan je urmā _______ rākhe chhe.
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami's kirtan says, "Harijan sāchā re, je urmā himmat rākhe..."

questions.question_text: Brahmanand Swami kirtan pramane, vipatti varatī re, kedī _______ nav bhākhe.
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami's kirtan says, "Vipatti varatī re, kedī dīn vachan nav bhākhe..."

questions.question_text: Brahmanand Swami kirtan pramane, Harijan jagnu sukhduḥkh shaṇu karī jāṇe chhe?
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami's kirtan states, "Jagnu sukhduḥkh re, māyik mithyā karī jāṇe..."

questions.question_text: Brahmanand Swami kirtan pramane, tan dhan jātā re, antarmā _______.
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami's kirtan states, "Tan dhan jātā re, antarmā shok na āṇe..."

questions.question_text: Brahmanand Swami kirtan pramane, par upkārī jan kyāmā pūrā chhe?
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami's kirtan states, "Par upkārī re, jan premniyammā pūrā..."

questions.question_text: Brahmanand Swami kirtan pramane, Harijan ahonish _______ Harine samare re.
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami's kirtan states, "Harine samare re, nitya ahonish umang bhariyā..."

questions.question_text: Brahmanand Swami kirtan pramane, evā harijannī balihārī, _______ jātā re, nav mele ṭek vichārī.
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami's kirtan states, "Mastak jātā re, nav mele ṭek vichārī..."
